_comment: Classification of every key of PLAN_LIMITS (packages/shared/src/planLimits.ts, moved from apps/api 2026-09-22 — see shared/decision.md, "S3"). scripts/generate.mjs fails if PLAN_LIMITS gains a key that is not listed here, so the enforcement question is asked the first time someone adds a limit. Only keys under `enforced` reach the public reference page. Re-verified 2026-09-22.

maxAgents.label: Concurrent agents per account
maxAgents.note: The hub looks up the account's real plan and applies that plan's limit; a same-label reconnect does not count against it. Was a single limit (PRO's) applied to every plan until 2026-09-22.

maxApiKeys.label: Active API keys
maxApiKeys.note: Counts active keys; revoked keys do not count.

maxScopesPerKey.label: Scopes per key
maxScopesPerKey.note: Checked when a key is created and when its scopes are changed.

prodKeysAllowed.label: Production (PROD) keys
prodKeysAllowed.note: Free accounts can only create DEV keys.

maxMembers.label: Account members
maxMembers.note: Counts current members plus pending invitations when one is sent, so an account can't send more invitations than it has room for; checked again when an invitation is accepted, since the limit or the membership can change while an invitation is pending. An account already over its limit from before this was enforced keeps its existing members — only the next new member is blocked.

publicPathRateLimitPerMinute.label: Public tunnel-URL requests per minute
publicPathRateLimitPerMinute.note: Per account, across every agent/label the account has connected — the public tunnel URL has no API key, so this can't be per-key like rateLimitPerMinute. Checked in-process before a request is forwarded; a refused request gets 429 with a Retry-After header. Load tests started from the dashboard skip it (their own limits apply). Added 2026-09-22 (session S5).

inspectorRequests.label: Requests kept in the request inspector (per tunnel, 24 h)
inspectorRequests.note: The hub keeps the most recent N requests of each tunnel for 24 hours; 0 turns capture off for the account.

accessRules.label: Tunnel access rules (password, IP allowlist, share links)
accessRules.note: Needed to create or change rules. Rules that exist keep protecting the tunnel after a downgrade.

inboxRequests.label: Requests held by a tunnel's webhook inbox while the agent is offline
inboxRequests.note: Once this many are waiting, further requests to the offline tunnel get 503. 0 means no inbox.

maxCustomDomains.label: Custom domains
maxCustomDomains.note: Needs the customDomains feature as well. Domains already added keep working after a downgrade.

maxAlertRules.label: Alert rules
maxAlertRules.note: Rules already created keep running after a downgrade.

customDomains.label: Custom domains allowed
customDomains.note: Gate for adding custom domains; how many is maxCustomDomains.

maxTrafficRules.label: Traffic rules per tunnel
maxTrafficRules.note: Rules already saved keep working after a downgrade; saving more than the limit is refused.

maxMockApis.label: Mock APIs
maxMockApis.note: Hosted mock APIs per account. Mocks that exist keep answering after a downgrade; creating more is refused.

maxMockEndpoints.label: Endpoints per mock API
maxMockEndpoints.note: Saving a mock with more endpoints is refused.

maxApiCollections.label: API client collections
maxApiCollections.note: Creating or importing more collections is refused; 0 turns the API client off for the account (sending is refused too).

maxApiCollectionRequests.label: Requests per collection
maxApiCollectionRequests.note: Saving or importing a collection with more requests is refused.

apiClientSendsPerMinute.label: API client sends per minute
apiClientSendsPerMinute.note: Every request the server-side runner sends counts, including each request of a collection run; over the limit the send answers 429 and a run skips the rest.

maxLoadTestVus.label: Load test virtual users
maxLoadTestVus.note: Starting a load test with more virtual users is refused; 0 turns load tests off for the account.

maxLoadTestSeconds.label: Longest load test
maxLoadTestSeconds.note: Starting a longer load test is refused.

maxLoadTestRps.label: Load test requests per second
maxLoadTestRps.note: The runner paces every load test to this rate (a lower cap can be set per test).

loadTestsPerDay.label: Load tests per day
loadTestsPerDay.note: Load tests started per account per UTC day; the next one is refused.

maxMonitors.label: Monitors
maxMonitors.note: Creating more monitors is refused; existing monitors keep running after a downgrade.

minMonitorIntervalMinutes.label: Shortest monitor interval
minMonitorIntervalMinutes.note: Creating or changing a monitor to run more often is refused.

notEnforced.maxRequestsPerMonth: Counted (both the SDK/API-key path and, as of 2026-09-22 session S5, the public tunnel-URL path) but not blocking — decided 2026-09-22 (shared/decision.md) to count and warn, not hard-enforce. The counting mechanism exists, and since 2026-10-06 owners and admins get an in-app + email notice at 80% and 100% (apps/api platform/alerts/notices.ts, setting billing.usageNotices).
notEnforced.rateLimitPerMinute: Only checked for TunnelClient (WebSocket SDK) requests; agents and the public tunnel URL are never rate limited by this per-key field, by design — a tunnel URL has no key to check (public webhook callers hold none). CORRECTED 2026-09-22: for TunnelClient requests the plan's real limit now survives a cache reload too (previously it reset to unlimited after ~5 minutes or any rotation/update/revoke). See shared/decision.md, "S3". The public tunnel-URL path now has its own, separate, per-account limit instead — see publicPathRateLimitPerMinute below (session S5).
notEnforced.allowedEnvironments: Unused; prodKeysAllowed is what is checked.
notEnforced.expiryAllowed: True on every plan since 2026-09-25 (expiry is a safety feature, not a paid one), so there is nothing to enforce; the dashboard lets any plan set an expiry date.
notEnforced.analyticsRetentionDays: No enforcement site. No retention job is scheduled (decided 2026-09-22, shared/decision.md).
